title: SEE: Unlocking the Hidden Perception of Frozen VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.23962v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) grasp the overall content of an image but often miss the fine details a question hinges on, such as a small object in a large photo or a number in a dense infographic. Yet even when their answer is wrong, the region they point to often contains the evidence. We introduce Self-Elicited Evidence (SEE), a training-free method that lets a frozen VLM look again where it points. When the initial answer has low confidence, SEE prompts the model to propose regions where the details may appear, answers the question on these enlarged crops, and aggregates the answers with the original prediction through confidence-weighted voting. The model also answers with its own transcript, which helps on text-rich images. SEE needs no detector or OCR engine. Across five backbones, SEE improves every small-object benchmark by 2.3-13.1 points and outperforms five training-free baselines on small objects. With SEE, Qwen3.5-4B surp

translated_title: SEE：解锁冻结视觉语言模型的隐藏感知能力
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够把握图像的整体内容，但常常遗漏问题所依赖的细微细节，例如大照片中的小物体或密集信息图中的数字。然而，即使它们的答案错误，它们所指的区域往往包含着证据。我们提出了自引证据，这是一种无需训练的方法，让冻结的VLM重新审视它所指的位置。当初始答案置信度较低时，SEE会提示模型提出细节可能出现的区域，在这些放大后的裁剪图像上回答问题，并通过置信度加权投票将答案与原始预测进行聚合。模型还会根据自己的转录文本进行回答，这有助于处理文本丰富的图像。SEE不需要检测器或OCR引擎。在五个骨干模型上，SEE将所有小物体基准测试提升了2.3-13.1个百分点，并在小物体任务上超越了五个无需训练的基线方法。借助SEE，Qwen3.5-4B的性能得到显著提升（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: SEE是一种无需训练的方法，通过让冻结的视觉语言模型在置信度低时重新审视并放大其所指区域进行作答，再以置信度加权投票聚合答案，从而显著提升小物体与细粒度感知能力。
en_tdlr: SEE is a training-free method that lets frozen VLMs re-examine and zoom into low-confidence regions they point to, aggregating answers via confidence-weighted voting to significantly boost small-object and fine-detail perception.
